react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert with multiple buttons (Sim/Não) does not render on web preview — react-native-web does not implement multi-button dialogs. Affects /conveniencia confirm flow and admin-clientes toggle-active confirm during web-based QA only; production iOS/Android renders correctly. Consider adding a small custom in-app modal component to have parity on all platforms (nice-to-have, not a mobile blocker). Reference: conveniencia.tsx:131-138 and admin-clientes.tsx (toggle-active handler).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace Alert.alert(...) multi-button confirmations with a lightweight custom RN modal (View + Overlay) so web preview and mobile behave identically. Currently confirmations work on device but are silent on web — not blocking mobile-first release.

OPTIONAL cosmetic (carried over from iter 10): centralize pt-BR money() helper using Intl.NumberFormat — thousands separators are now present (R$ 4.901,00 shown), verify all screens use formatMoney (src/format.ts). Already largely consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:252-271 scheduling window validation: computes now_br() and req_date, rejects delta_days<0 or >1, and enforces scheduled-now >= 1h. Uses BR_TZ correctly. Trivially correct.
server.py:852-886 create_authorization: normalizes cpf, requires person_name, coerces can_lower to bool, strips service or None. Persists both fields — good.
server.py:630-642 set_user_active idempotent PATCH; returns full User model.
server.py:322-324 login: checks active is False explicitly (not falsy — protects legacy users without 'active' field which default to True). Correct.
server.py:984-997 reboque_quote_endpoint accepts client_lat/lng OR distance and 400 otherwise. Correct.
server.py:940-947 haversine_nm converts km→NM via /1.852; rounded 2dp — matches admin UI display.
server.py:1170-1204 send_statement upserts by (cpf,month) via delete_many+insert_one, guaranteeing single notification per month per client. Rebuild uses consumo_report internally — DRY.
server.py:1108-1167 consumo_report: cpf filter applied to both orders and reboques queries; grand_total = sum of client totals; sorted desc — clean.
server.py:57-88 put_object/get_object handle 503 by refreshing storage_key — resilient.
conveniencia.tsx:130-139 confirm dialog renders total via formatMoney helper — pattern OK; only reservation is RN Web Alert limitation noted above.
autorizar.tsx:162-188 toggle + service input follow standard styles; state cleared on successful submit; date required check works.
fatura.tsx:26-49 auto-reads on focus and marks unread statements as read; robust try/catch.
admin-clientes.tsx:246 toggle-active-{cpf} testID is stable per user; admin-relatorio.tsx:144 enviar-resumo-{cpf} pattern too.
No _id leaks: all Mongo find() calls project {'_id':0}, and insert_one docs have doc.pop('_id', None) before return.

server.py currently 1289 lines — still monolithic. Suggest splitting into routers/{users,requests,conveniencia,authorizations,emergencies,statements,reports}.py for maintainability (>700-line guideline).
